Web Design with 0 Minutes Downtime

You can get a website designed with 0 minutes downtime, and you can start by checking out the custom website launch package on this site. This package includes a custom design, up to 5 pages, contact forms, and SEO basics, all for a one-time fee of $2,950.

How it Works for a Downtime-Free Website

To get a website with 0 minutes downtime, you can opt for the Launch package, which includes a custom design and hosting on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub for $0/month. The process takes about a week, and you get 90 days of free care after launch. You can also check out the flagship case study, us250tour.com, which has 2,100+ photos, 78 GB, and 0 minutes downtime.

What You Get and What it Costs

The Launch package costs $2,950, with a 50% deposit and the balance due at launch. You also get 90 days of free care after launch, and then you can opt for care plans at $295/month or $595/month. You own the site outright, including the code, content, and domain.

FAQ

What happens after the 90 days of free care? You can opt for care plans at $295/month or $595/month, and you can cancel any time. Do I have to pay for hosting? No, hosting is $0/month on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub. How long does it take to launch a website? It takes about a week to launch a website with the Launch package.
